workshoptitle: Migrate Red Hat Enterprise Linux to Oracle Linux on OCI

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the complete migration journey, architecture, prerequisites, and success criteria.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Acquire and Import the RHEL Source Image
tutorials.description: Obtain and import the authorized raw RHEL image.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Prepare and Export the RHEL Application Image
tutorials.description: Prepare RHEL with Apache, remove registration, capture and export the reusable image, and create its object-read PAR.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Import and Verify the RHEL Application Image
tutorials.description: Import the prepared image into the destination tenancy, launch a VM, and verify the application and registration cleanup.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Linux Command-Line Quickstart
tutorials.description: Practice everyday commands and produce a readiness report.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Assess Readiness and Protect the Source
tutorials.description: Capture the destination baseline, assess readiness, and choose an optional backup.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Migrate to Oracle Linux
tutorials.description: Convert in place, reboot into Oracle RHCK, and verify the application.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Validate the Migration
tutorials.description: Compare migration evidence and review package exceptions before further practice.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Explore Oracle Linux Kernel Choices
tutorials.description: Install and boot UEK 8, retain RHCK as fallback, and retest the migrated application.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Explore Rebootless Patching with Ksplice
tutorials.description: Check eligibility, install Uptrack, evaluate available live patches, and compare boot identity and application observations.

tutorials.title: Lab 10: Maintain Oracle Linux Packages
tutorials.description: Inspect repositories, preview selected maintenance, install a utility, and verify the application.

tutorials.title: Lab 11: Configure and Troubleshoot Apache
tutorials.description: Configure practice content, inspect logs, and recover a stopped service.

tutorials.title: Lab 12: Manage Application Security
tutorials.description: Practice permissions, SELinux file contexts, and runtime/permanent firewall rules.

tutorials.title: Lab 13: Back Up and Restore the Application
tutorials.description: Archive application content and configuration, restore selected files, and verify recovery.

tutorials.title: Lab 14: Automate Application Health Checks
tutorials.description: Create a script and systemd timer, detect a fault, recover, and optionally clean up.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Review common solutions and options for assistance.
